The Gladiators strike back with a thrilling win!
Rome Gladiators chased down the target to secure a 5-wicket victory over Napoli Knights in Match 2 of 2026!
Napoli Knights posted 73/9 before the Gladiators chased it down in 9.4 overs, sealing the win with just two balls to spare!
